candidates.title: Directed tangent transport with an explicit codeword-separation barrier
candidates.falsifier: Reject if the checker finds a non-finite or zero codebook gradient, if exchanging source and target leaves the loss unchanged, or if a probe shows pair-codeword separation failing to increase for below-delta pairs. After the admitted run, the candidate is wrong if pair-level ER does not rise while level-0 Gini, L1-to-L2 branches per code, train-to-test frequency drift, and sequence information all meet the stated control-relative constraints, or if Stage-3 recall@10 does not exceed 0.06406796775709883.
candidates.risk: The separation barrier may preserve distance but not useful item distinctions: codewords could be pushed apart in directions unrelated to the catalogue partition, worsening held-out assignment structure or frequency drift. The fixed nearest-codeword assignments also make the objective locally blind to assignment changes until the Voronoi boundary is crossed.
candidates.codebook_interaction: The transport term moves the target-assigned codeword toward a small directed step from the source-assigned codeword. The hinge barrier acts only when the two assigned codewords are closer than delta and pushes them apart; it therefore opposes pair convergence rather than rewarding a shared code. Both assignments are computed from the supplied codebook; assignment indices are discrete and have no gradient.

candidates.title: Directed soft assignment matching with a prefix-information-preserving codebook barrier
candidates.falsifier: Reject if exchanging source and target leaves the loss unchanged, if the codebook gradient is zero or non-finite, or if the source gradient is absent despite its declared target. The probe falsifies the proposal if pair-assigned codeword distances shrink materially, or if exported level-0 Gini exceeds control, L1-to-L2 branches fall below control, train-to-test frequency drift grows, or sequence information falls.
candidates.risk: Soft assignment matching can still concentrate marginal usage or reduce prefix diversity even with a per-pair entropy floor; the barrier controls individual source distributions, not catalogue-wide Gini, prefix branches, frequency drift, or sequence information. The chosen temperature may also make gradients too diffuse or too sharp.
candidates.codebook_interaction: The directional KL term adjusts codebook positions so the source assignment distribution predicts the detached target distribution. The entropy barrier prevents the source distribution for a pair from becoming arbitrarily concentrated on a single code; unlike pairwise cross-entropy, it does not directly pull the two endpoint codewords together to serve both endpoints. It can still move codewords toward one another indirectly, so pairwise codeword distances must be checked in the probe.

candidates.title: Behaviour-conditioned residual tangent alignment with endpoint separation
candidates.falsifier: Reject if source-target exchange does not change the loss, if the declared codebook gradient is zero or non-finite, or if the probe shows the separation barrier fails on below-delta pairs. The proposal is falsified by an admitted export whose pair-level ER fails to rise, whose level-0 Gini exceeds control, whose L1-to-L2 branch count is below control, whose train-to-test frequency drift grows, whose sequence information falls, or whose Stage-3 recall@10 fails to exceed 0.06406796775709883.
candidates.risk: Residuals are defined relative to hard nearest-codeword assignments, so the objective may be locally discontinuous at assignment boundaries and may optimize residual alignment without improving the global partition. The separation floor could also waste codebook capacity or increase assignment frequency drift.
candidates.codebook_interaction: The residual term differentiates through c^s_i and c^t_i, moving the assigned codewords to make the detached endpoint residual difference align with the directed behaviour tangent. The separation hinge independently repels the two assigned codewords whenever their distance is below delta. Thus residual alignment cannot reward merging the endpoints, and the hinge directly prevents close pair-codeword convergence.
